prompt_text: What is the best tool for an Airbnb host to set nightly pricing and analyze a market before buying?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- For market research before buying: AirDNA (MarketMinder) is widely considered the best single tool.
- For setting nightly pricing once you have listings: PriceLabs is the most flexible and widely used; Beyond Pricing and Wheelhouse are good turnkey alternatives.

Why (short)
- AirDNA gives neighborhood-level ADR, occupancy, revenue, seasonality, historical trends, and projected performance for short‑term rentals — exactly what you need to screen prospective investment markets.
- PriceLabs gives powerful, customizable dynamic pricing rules, minimum‑stay controls, and integrates with most PMS/airbnb channels so you can optimize nightly rates daily.

How to use them together
1. Market screen (AirDNA)
   - Pull ADR, occupancy, RevPAR and revenue estimates for the neighborhood(s).
   - Inspect seasonality, historical performance and supply growth (new listings).
   - Look at top comps by property type (studio/1BR/2BR) and compare amenities and minimum stays.
   - Check regulatory risk and local permit requirements.

2. Run pro forma
   - Build revenue scenarios (conservative/realistic/optimistic) using AirDNA ADR and occupancy.
   - Subtract estimated expenses: mortgage, taxes, insurance, HOA, utilities, cleaning, management, platform fees, maintenance, vacancy buffer.
   - Compute cash flow, cap rate, and cash-on-cash return.

3. Pricing and revenue management (PriceLabs / Beyond Pricing / Wheelhouse)
   - After purchase/listing: connect your calendar and enable dynamic pricing.
   - Start with conservative minimums, then monitor booking pace and let the algorithm update ADR daily.
   - Use PriceLabs if you want granular controls (custom rules for season/last‑minute/length‑of‑stay). Use Beyond Pricing or Wheelhouse if you prefer set‑and‑forget automation.

Other useful tools and data sources
- Mashvisor: alternative for quick comparative analysis, sometimes easier for long‑term vs short‑term comparisons.
- AllTheRooms / Transparent: enterprise-level analytics (more expensive).
- Zillow/Redfin/Local MLS: comps and cap rates for purchase price assumptions.
- Manual Airbnb searches: verify comps, read reviews, check calendar patterns, and see real photos.

Practical tips
- Don’t rely on platform estimates alone — combine AirDNA outputs with manual checks (search the same neighborhood on Airbnb).
- Look at supply growth and permit issuance trends — markets can get saturated quickly.
- Run sensitivity analysis (ADR ±10–20%, occupancy ±10 points) when deciding whether a purchase will cash flow.
- Consider a short free trial/demos — AirDNA and PriceLabs offer trials or sample reports.

If you tell me the city or neighborhood you’re looking at and the property type (studio/1BR/2BR), I can recommend which market metrics to focus on and help sketch a basic pro forma.
